WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS rental_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_total) AS avg_amount FROM rental_totals
),
above_avg_rentals AS (
  SELECT 
    rt.store_id,
    rt.rental_total
  FROM rental_totals rt, overall_avg oa
  WHERE rt.rental_total > oa.avg_amount
)
SELECT 
  store_id,
  SUM(rental_total) AS combined_payment_total,
  (SUM(rental_total) / COUNT(*) - (SELECT avg_amount FROM overall_avg)) AS avg_beat_by
FROM above_avg_rentals
GROUP BY store_id
ORDER BY store_id
